relationships.rationale: The rule limits Level 2 to responses covering breakdown and the use of both nitrogen and carbon compounds.
The guidance specifies the key breakdown and use ideas needed to satisfy the Level 2 rule.
The guidance sets the entry benchmark for Level 1 as one key idea plus another idea from the indicative-content blocks.
Clarifies that the indicative content is not exhaustive and that other ideas of the same standard may also receive credit.
The commentary explains that the Level 2 descriptor is applied holistically and contains three available marks.
The commentary explains that the Level 1 descriptor is applied holistically and contains three available marks.
The commentary explicitly accepts chlorophyll production as another named example of nitrate-ion use.

warnings: The non-exhaustive-content guidance was not linked because no aggregate indicative-content segment is provided, and attaching it to individual points would overstate its specificity.
